items.stem: Pampas Leather made a profit before tax of £300,000. Corporation tax is 20% and the directors pay out 40% of profit after tax as dividends. There are 200,000 shares. Calculate profit after tax, total dividends, retained profit and the dividend per share.
items.answer: Tax = £60,000; profit after tax = £240,000; dividends = £96,000; retained profit = £144,000; dividend per share = £0.48.
items.markingKey: 300,000 × 20% = 60,000; 300,000 − 60,000 = 240,000; 40% × 240,000 = 96,000; 240,000 − 96,000 = 144,000; 96,000/200,000 = 0.48. [M1] for a correct formula/method with substituted values; [A1] for all four values. Units (%, $, days, times) required for [A1]. Apply own figure rule (OFR) to later parts.

items.answer: The statement of profit or loss shows income, costs and profit over a period; the statement of financial position shows assets, liabilities and equity at a point in time.

items.answer: Straight-line charges the same amount every year; units of production charges depreciation according to how much the asset is used each year.
